NO reporting-period box is checked; the only Type-of-Report mark is the amendment 'Yes' box with 'SEPT 15, 2006' written beside it, so report_type is blank. The cover's signature Date rule was left BLANK; the Summary Page's Date-of-Report box reads 10/6/06 and the clerk stamp is OCT 06 2006. Form arithmetic checks out.

contributions.detail: exact (55,759.34 = 55,759.34); 64 rows across p3-p4 sum to the attachment's own printed 'Total' on p4, which equals Summary Page line 1 and line 4

expenditures.detail: exact in magnitude and exact against the schedule's own total. Every amount on this ledger-export attachment is printed with a LEADING MINUS and so is its printed 'Total' (-36,202.06); the 76 transcribed rows sum to -36,202.06, gating EXACTLY against that printed total. The Summary Page prints the same figure positive (36,202.06) on lines 2 and 6. The minus signs are retained verbatim rather than dropped, so a consumer must take the magnitude - this is the source's sign convention, not 76 refunds.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The county form pages carry only 'See attached'; the p5 Schedule B form leaves SUBTOTAL blank but writes TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE 36202.06 by hand. itemized.notes: THIS IS A BUNDLE AND ONLY PART OF IT BELONGS TO THIS FILING. Pages: 1 cover, 2 (Summary/Schedule A county form), 3-4 the Schedule A attachment for the period 'June 20, 2006 - September 10, 2006' (grand total 55,759.34 on p4), 5 the Schedule B county form ('See attached', TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE 36202.06 written in by hand), 6-7 the Schedule B attachment for the same period (grand total -36,202.06 on p7), 8 the SUMMARY PAGE (hand-numbered 'Page 8 of 8'), 9 a QuickBooks report headed 'Received Payments for All Customers, January through December 2006' printed 06/20/06 and totalling 22,370.00, and 10 a two-line contribution list dated 3/10/2006 and 3/20/2006. PAGES 9 AND 10 WERE NOT TRANSCRIBED INTO EITHER SIDE: their dates (April-June 2006 and March 2006) fall OUTSIDE this report's stated period, they carry their own separate totals, and they are not inside this filing's printed totals - they are carry-over attachments from the earlier report. Both sides of THIS filing gate exactly without them. A human should decide whether p9/p10 belong to an earlier Winder filing. The Summary Page's Column B (Sum Total to Date) reads 85,129.34 / 62,487.39 - preserved here only as context, not transcribed as rows. Two contribution rows are the CANDIDATE'S OWN LOANS (Jim Winder, 15,000.00 and 20,000.00, occupation cell '(Personal Loan)') and carry needs_review=1; one is the filer's '< $50' aggregate (1,131.01, no date).
